# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 22 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 5 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Gradient — 8 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #ffffff | #1b1f38 | Page ground. White in light; rhino-950 in dark. |
| `surface-raised` | #dee3ff | #2e3558 | Panels and tiles sitting on surface. |
| `surface-deep` | #2e3558 | #0d1028 | Inverted / hero bands inside a page. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--ink);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #2e3558 | #ffffff | Headings and body on surface and surface-raised (light 11.9:1 / 9.4:1; dark 16.2:1 / 11.9:1). |
| `ink-muted` | #808080 | #b1bcff | Captions, footers. Dark: 8.9:1 on surface. Light keeps the source's #808080 at 3.95:1 on white — FLAG: use only at 24px+ or for legal lines; use ink for anything essential. |
| `ink-accent` | #5961ed | #8c9dff | Highlighted words and links on surface (light 4.8:1, dark 6.5:1). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--rhino);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (22)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rhino` | #2e3558 | #2e3558 | Primary brand colour (RGB 46 53 88 · CMYK 48/40/0/65). The wordmark, headings on white, primary dark grounds. 11.9:1 on white. |
| `periwinkle` | #8c9dff | #8c9dff | Secondary / accent (RGB 140 157 255 · CMYK 45/38/0/0). Supporting highlight only — fills, glows, highlighted words on dark. Never body text on white (2.5:1). |
| `chrome-yellow` | #ffa601 | #ffa601 | Secondary / accent (RGB 255 166 1 · CMYK 0/35/100/0). Calls to action, stripe motif, key highlights on rhino grounds (6.1:1). Never text on white (2.0:1). |
| `white` | #ffffff | #ffffff | Core neutral. Light grounds and text on rhino, rhino-950 and midnight. |
| `rangoon-black` | #1a1a1a | #1a1a1a | Core neutral (CMYK 0/0/0/90). Long-form body text on white (17.4:1) and dark print collateral. |
| `midnight` | #0d1028 | #0d1028 | Gradient stop (RGB 13 16 40 · CMYK 67/60/0/84) for Gradient 02 and Background 04; also the header wordmark ink on white. |
| `chrome-yellow-400` | #ffb62d | #ffb62d | Chrome Yellow semitone. Hover state of chrome-yellow fills. |
| `chrome-yellow-200` | #ffd68a | #ffd68a | Chrome Yellow semitone. Soft highlight fills behind rhino text. |
| `chrome-yellow-100` | #ffe6b7 | #ffe6b7 | Chrome Yellow semitone. Palest warm tint for callout panels. |
| `accent` | #8c9dff | #8c9dff | Periwinkle fill for supporting highlights — glows, secondary buttons, chips. |
| `highlight` | #ffa601 | #ffa601 | Chrome Yellow fill for the one primary action or key mark per view. |
| `focus-ring` | #5961ed | #ffa601 | 2px solid focus outline (light 4.8:1 on white, dark 8.2:1 on rhino-950). |

| ramp | steps | first → last (light) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rhino-*` | 500, 600, 800, 950 | #5961ed → #1b1f38 |
| `periwinkle-*` | 100, 300, 600 | #dee3ff → #5972ff |
| `neutral-*` | 100, 500, 800 | #eaeaea → #323232 |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-h1);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 96px / 1.2 | 700 | `sans` | Heading H1 — Avenir LT Pro Bold 96px. One per slide or page. |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 64px / 1.2 | 600 | `sans` | Heading H2 — Avenir LT Pro Semi Bold 64px. |
| `sh1` | `.sh1`, `--text-sh1` | 64px / 1.2 | 500 | `sans` | Sub Headline SH1 — Avenir LT Pro Medium 64px. |
| `sh2` | `.sh2`, `--text-sh2` | 48px / 1.2 | 500 | `sans` | Sub Headline SH2 — Avenir LT Pro Medium 48px. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 48px / 1.2 | 400 | `sans` | Paragraph Body — Avenir LT Pro Book 48px on the 1920px canvas. |
| `social-headline` | `.social-headline`, `--text-social-headline` | 64px / 1.1 | 700 | `sans` | Social media (short-form, carousels, statics): letter spacing -4 to -6%, line spacing 95–120%. Size follows the scale slot used. |
| `print-headline` | `.print-headline`, `--text-print-headline` | 64px / 1.2 | 700 | `sans` | Print & high-detail collateral (brochures, PPTs, PDFs): letter spacing 0 to -2%, line spacing 100–120%. |
| `ui-headline` | `.ui-headline`, `--text-ui-headline` | 64px / 1.2 | 700 | `sans` | UI & digital interfaces (web, dashboards, apps): letter spacing 0%, default line spacing. |
| `explainer-italic` | `.explainer-italic`, `--text-explainer-italic` | 64px / 1.2 | 400 | `serif` | Besley Italic — explainer titles and one emphasised phrase beside Avenir. Never long-form. |
| `display-futura` | `.display-futura`, `--text-display-futura` | 64px / 1.1 | 700 | `display` | Futura Bold — short uppercase display labels, may take a brand gradient fill. |
| `hand-note` | `.hand-note`, `--text-hand-note` | 48px / 1.2 | 400 | `hand` | Figma Hand — a short handwritten aside. Never paired as a headline with Avenir, never long-form. |

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`) and upload it as an asset where you use it (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) — HTML/CSS: an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule; a Slides deck: write `fonts/<id>` = `{"family":"<family>","src":"<the url the upload returned>"}`. `tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that inlines it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

## Spacing

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 8px | Tight gaps: icon to label, stacked caption lines. |
| `space-2` | 16px | Button padding block, gaps inside cards. |
| `space-3` | 24px | Card padding, gutters between tiles. |
| `space-4` | 40px | Section padding on small canvases; page margins on the 1080 social formats. |
| `space-5` | 64px | Page margins on the 1920 canvas and large section breaks. |

## Gradient

Brand gradients and the approved background treatments, as CSS background values. Use them as background, never as text colour on body copy.

### Use

```css
/* var(--gradient-01) */
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gradient-01` | linear-gradient(135deg, #2E3558 0%, #2E3558 45%, #8C9DFF 100%) | Gradient 01 — Rhino into Periwinkle. Hero panels and covers. Direction and stops measured from the guidelines. |
| `gradient-02` | radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 65%, #0D1028 0%, #2E3558 75%) | Gradient 02 — Rhino with a Midnight core. Deep, quiet dark grounds. |
| `gradient-03` | linear-gradient(135deg, #FFA601 0%, #8C9DFF 75%) | Gradient 03 — Chrome Yellow into Periwinkle. Rare, expressive moments; set rhino-950 or white type at display size only. |
| `gradient-04` | linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #8C9DFF 70%) | Gradient 04 — White into Periwinkle. Light, airy panels; rhino text. |
| `gradient-amalgamation` | linear-gradient(150deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #FFA601 35%, #8C9DFF 65%, #2E3558 100%) | Amalgamation — all core colours blended. Campaign key visuals only; approximation of a mesh gradient. |
| `background-01` | linear-gradient(180deg, #5D6CB3 0%, #1B1F38 100%) | Approved Background 01 — dusk fade from lifted rhino to rhino-950 (top stop sampled). |
| `background-03` | linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 55%, #DEE3FF 100%) | Approved Background 03 — white with a periwinkle-100 fade at the foot. |
| `background-04` | linear-gradient(180deg, #0D1028 55%, #2E3558 100%) | Approved Background 04 — midnight lifting to rhino at the foot. |
